'''Maxhagan''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who settled in [[Greenwood Station]] on the planet [[Nox (planet)|Nox]].<ref name="Void" />

==Biography==
According to [[Tre Sana]], in [[25,797 BBY]], Maxhagan was crossed by a family from [[Volke House]] on [[Shikaakwa]], which bought information from Maxhagan but refused to pay. In response, Maxhagan initiated a [[feud in Crystal City]] that destroyed the Volke family's entire network on Nox and left three thousand others dead.<ref name="Void" />

By [[25,793 BBY]], Maxhagan was making all of his money from information, through his control of the [[Network]], a collection of informants which reach extended beyond Greenwood Station to all of Nox. It is known that he had conducted business with Tre Sana, though they did not meet and their business did not involve the Network. Maxhagan later dealt with Tre Sana and [[Lanoree Brock]], finding the whereabouts of Lanoree's brother, [[Dalien Brock]], for a fee.<ref name="Void" />

{{Char-stub}}

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|But Maxhagan isn't someone to fool with. He's the real deal. A maniac. A monster.|[[Tre Sana]] to [[Lanoree Brock]]|<ref name="Void" />}}
[[Tre Sana]] described Maxhagan as a sharp and brutal, saying he would have had no trouble sleeping after three thousand sentients died as a result of his actions. When [[Lanoree Brock]] touched his mind, her impression was that his thoughts were akin to a pit of filth.<ref name="Void" />

Maxhagan chose to remain in the open rather than hide, running a stall that sold imported water in [[District Six]], but this did not belie a lack of caution. He kept armed men covertly around him as bodyguards, and had implants that enhanced his ability to keep [[Je'daii]] out of his thoughts.<ref name="Void" />
